_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base-rate coil (~25% of windows move ±2) plus dead ETF flows, neutral funding, and mid momentum give no breaker to leave Disbelief.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both non-bullish, but analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief vs narrative distribution pressure without a clean phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 55-68, 30d momentum 45-70, funding near neutral, ETF flows still dead
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum >75 with funding >65 (up Hope) OR F&G <50 with dvol >90 and price rollover (down Complacency)
